SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] Onii-san! Come on, look!

[FI] At the moment, we're 100 meters above ground-- 
Inside one of the Giant Sky Wheel's gondolas.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] Look, that's the park we were in, isn't it?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Seeing it from here, it looks pretty small, huh.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] It does...

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] Onii-san, aren't you going to look outside?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] I'm busy looking at you, Ayase.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT:
[FI] ...Eh? O-Onii-san, please don't say such embarrassing 
things.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Y-You think so? I was just being honest though.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] And I'm telling you that's embarrassing, geez...

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] Come look from here. You can see all of Odaiba.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Okay.

[FI] Ayase was pulling at me strongly to her side so I 
could get a better vie--

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Whoa!

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] Eek?!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Um...

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT:
[FI] M-Maybe we shouldn't make any sudden 
movements...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Y-You're right...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Say, Ayase.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] What is it?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Mind if I sit next to you?

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] Eh? That's fine, but...

[FI] Getting Ayase's permission, I moved to sit down 
next to her.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT:
[FI] ...Somehow, this is making me feel more nervous 
than usual.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Y-Yeah.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] C-Chiba is that way!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] ...Can I hold your hand?

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] Eh?! ...T-That's fine.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] Ah... T-This is pretty embarrassing, isn't it?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Y-Yeah...

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] But I don't hate it.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Y-Yeah.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] I wonder what Kirino is doing right now...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Well, I think I can guess.

[FI] Seemed like she was still at home when I left, so 
she's probably stuck in her room playing some 
galge.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] ...I see. You might be right.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] ...This is pretty high.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Could it be that you're bad with heights?

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT:
[FI] Ah, no, not at all. It's just... I guess it's a bit scary 
since we're this far above ground.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] So, how about we hug each other then?

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] Eh? W-What are you saying out of the blue?!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] No, I was just thinking it might be less scary that 
way.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] That in itself is scary in a whole different way...

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] [font_size=17]Besides, this isn't the time for that, or rather the mood isn't right...[/font_size]

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Huh? What did you say?

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] N-Nothing at all.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] Onii-san, how about you?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Me? Guess I'm a bit scared.

[FI] Certainly, falling from this height would be quite 
bad.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT:
[FI] I think it's pretty cute how you can be so honest, 
Onii-san.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] You know, calling a guy cute doesn't make him 
happy.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] Is that how it is?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Of course it is.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] Hehe, I'll keep that in mind.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT:
[FI] It was pretty interesting seeing everything from 
above, don't you think?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Yeah, it's great.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] Let's ride together again sometime!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] Does that mean you want to have another date in 
Odaiba?

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] Well, of course. Any number of times.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] What's wrong, Ayase? ...You didn't think it was 
boring, did you?

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] No, it was fun. It was fun, but...

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] How to put it... I guess I'm just a bit tired.
